chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Cab refuses to let Herman Stark fire the band
summary: When Herman Stark demanded they be fired, Cab said nobody fires his band but him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Now, we walk back, we get back to Forty-Eighth Street, and there was Cab Calloway and Herman Stark out in the street waiting for us. And the one beautiful thing that Danny was saying about Cab, which was verified... Herman Stark is raising cain, and hollering, "The show was on, and there you'all are running up and down the street! Fire 'em, Cab. Fire 'em!" And Herman Stark was the boss. He says,

"What are you gonna do?" Cab said, "Look, this is my band. Don't nobody fire nobody in this band but me." He said, "Now, you all get on back upstairs." Because he bawled the daylights out of us later, but he wouldn't let anyone else give you... He wouldn't let anyone else interfere in the band.
No. Don't mess with his band.
